title: Incoming MotoGP R3 and Festival shared CPU compatibility

integrationScope: Completed focused CPU compatibility run for the shared changes incoming through 493e937b5f48b22a4dc08804a8a17323d539186b: GP cooling louvers and slipstream, shared effects/spray, catalogue body construction and ownership, and Festival vehicle/traffic presentation. derivedResult.suiteCounterNote: Vitest suite counters include nested suites. Test-file count is testResults.length, not numTotalTestSuites.

timing.durationMethod: Each file duration is endTime minus startTime using the decimal values serialized in the original report. The run window is max(file.endTime) minus report.startTime; it is not a recorded process wall duration and excludes any later teardown/report writing. File durations are not summed to infer wall time. UTC labels are displayed to milliseconds; Unix millisecond values retain the original precision.

sourceIdentityNote: The original CPU reporter JSON contains no commit, source digest or build fingerprint. No later source/build identity has been retroactively attached to this run.
reproduction: Parse the original report identified by SHA-256. Project every testResults entry; count assertionResults by status; derive file paths relative to the repository; subtract reported decimal start/end timestamps. Reconcile these counts with reportedResult. No current-source hash is substituted for historical provenance.
